map.咬肌玻尿酸/肉毒区分: Distinguishing masseter hyaluronic acid from botulinum toxin
map.：输入：咬肌肥大想瘦脸 → 通常选肉毒素按两侧单位计，而非玻尿酸；本工具提示别混: : Input: masseter hypertrophy with a wish for a slimmer face -> botulinum toxin is usually chosen, counted in units per side, rather than hyaluronic acid; this tool warns against confusing the materials.
map.为什么同一部位有人多有人少？: Why does the amount differ between people for the same site?
map.肌肉体积、表情强度、既往用量都不同，需医师个体化。: Muscle volume, expression strength and previous doses all differ, so a physician must individualize the treatment.
map.单位算多会有什么后果？: What happens if too many units are calculated?
map.肉毒素过量可致表情僵硬、下垂；玻尿酸过量可致位移肿胀，均应及时就医。: Too much botulinum toxin can cause a stiff expression and drooping; too much hyaluronic acid can cause displacement and swelling; seek medical attention promptly in either case.
